description: The facts of a parcel (cadastre, building, land use, planning, terrain, hazards, infrastructure, proximity, energy, climate, soil, sunlight, valuation). Give fields, groups or a preset for a short answer; without them the answer has every field (about 700, in 5 parts or so). Each field has value, unit and src (a key of the sources table of the answer: name, provider, licence); fields without a value are counted (counts.without_value), not listed. A large answer comes in parts: next_cursor gives the next part (same arguments + cursor). Each answer starts with cite_as: the source line with the link of the unacasa page.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous part, with the same other arguments

fields.description: field keys from list_fields; a key ending in * is a prefix

groups.description: groups: cadastre, building, land_use, farming, planning, terrain, hazards, infrastructure, proximity (incl. schools, health, shops, transport, parks), area (census section income, age, origin, households), location, energy, valuation, climate, soil, sunlight

preset.description: farmland, buyer_home, climate, soil, hazards or building

refcat.description: cadastral reference of the parcel (14 characters, e.g. 8960309VK3786B)

name: get_parcel_facts
title: Parcel facts
